programmes.name_local: สิทธิประโยชน์ส่งเสริมการลงทุน (BOI) สำหรับธุรกิจเทคโนโลยีเป้าหมาย
programmes.name_en: Thailand Board of Investment Incentives for Targeted Technology Businesses
programmes.funder: สำนักงานคณะกรรมการส่งเสริมการลงทุน (Thailand Board of Investment, BOI)
programmes.amount_note: Not a cash grant. BOI promotion for targeted technology activities (biotechnology, nanotechnology, advanced materials, digital) provides corporate income tax exemption for up to 8 to 13 years, import duty exemptions on machinery and materials, permission for 100% foreign ownership, land ownership rights, and facilitated visas and work permits through the One Stop Service and SMART Visa.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the BOI e-Investment system. Approval timelines depend on the size of the investment.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the business activity is on the BOI list of promoted activities.
Submit the application through the BOI e-Investment system.
Attend the BOI project presentation interview.
BOI approval and issuance of the promotion certificate (application for the certificate must follow within the prescribed period).
Comply with conditions on capital, technology transfer and reporting to retain the incentives.

documents_required.doc: BOI application form and project description

eligibility.other_note: Open to Thai and foreign-owned companies. Minimum investment thresholds apply (lower for technology and digital activities), and specific conditions attach to each promoted activity category.

programmes.source_snippet: The Thailand Board of Investment grants tax and non-tax incentives to promoted activities including targeted technology industries.

programmes.name_local: มาตรการช่วยเหลือหรือการอุดหนุนการเริ่มต้นธุรกิจอุตสาหกรรมดิจิทัล (depa Digital Startup Fund)
programmes.funder: สำนักงานส่งเสริมเศรษฐกิจดิจิทัล (Digital Economy Promotion Agency, depa)
programmes.amount_note: Tiered support for digital startups. The early-stage tier (Fund S1) provides smaller amounts for proof of concept, while later tiers support market expansion, with awards historically up to around THB 1 million per project depending on the tier and matching requirements.
programmes.deadline_note: depa operates several funding measures with rolling and periodic intake depending on the measure. Check the depa fund page for currently open measures.
programmes.reopen_note: depa's funding measures are revised with each annual plan. If a measure is closed, other depa measures (for example digital transformation vouchers for SMEs) are often open.

procedure_steps.detail: Review the currently open depa funding measures.
Register on the depa fund portal and submit the proposal.
Screening and committee review.
Agreement and milestone-based disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: Thai-registered digital businesses, with some measures also open to individuals and community enterprises. Thai shareholding requirements apply.

programmes.source_snippet: depa มีมาตรการช่วยเหลือและอุดหนุนสำหรับผู้ประกอบการดิจิทัลและสตาร์ทอัพ

programmes.name_local: ทุนนวัตกรรมแบบเปิด (Open Innovation)
programmes.funder: สำนักงานนวัตกรรมแห่งชาติ (National Innovation Agency, NIA)
programmes.amount_note: Grant of up to THB 1.5 million per project covering up to 75% of project cost, for developing an innovation prototype through to commercial readiness. Project duration is typically up to 12 months.
programmes.deadline_note: NIA runs multiple calls per year with defined submission windows announced on the NIA MIS portal.
programmes.reopen_note: Open Innovation is NIA's flagship recurring grant and reopens in multiple rounds each Thai fiscal year (October to September). Register on mis.nia.or.th to be notified of the next call.

procedure_steps.detail: Register a company account on the NIA MIS portal.
Submit a concept paper describing the innovation and market.
If the concept is accepted, submit the full proposal with budget and workplan.
Expert committee review and pitch.
Contract signing and milestone-based disbursement, with the company funding its share up front.

eligibility.other_note: Thai-registered juristic person with at least 51% Thai shareholding. The innovation must be new to Thailand and the applicant must be able to fund at least 25% of the project cost.

programmes.source_snippet: ทุนนวัตกรรมแบบเปิดสนับสนุนการพัฒนาโครงการนวัตกรรมของผู้ประกอบการไทย

programmes.name_local: ทุนนวัตกรรมมุ่งเป้า (Thematic Innovation)
programmes.funder: สำนักงานนวัตกรรมแห่งชาติ (National Innovation Agency, NIA)
programmes.amount_note: Larger grant of up to THB 5 million per project covering up to 75% of project cost, for innovation projects addressing specific national priority themes announced by NIA (such as ARI-Tech, climate, food and agriculture, and medical innovation).
programmes.deadline_note: Theme-specific calls with defined windows announced on the NIA MIS portal, usually one to three calls per year.
programmes.reopen_note: NIA announces new thematic priorities each fiscal year. Monitor mis.nia.or.th and nia.or.th for the next thematic call and its priority areas.

procedure_steps.detail: Check which thematic areas are currently open.
Register on the NIA MIS portal.
Submit the concept paper against the theme.
Submit the full proposal if invited.
Committee review and pitch.
Contract and milestone-based disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Concept paper aligned to the announced theme

eligibility.other_note: Thai-registered juristic person with at least 51% Thai shareholding, with a project fitting the announced thematic priority.

programmes.source_snippet: ทุนนวัตกรรมมุ่งเป้าสนับสนุนโครงการนวัตกรรมในสาขาที่กำหนดเป็นเป้าหมายของประเทศ

programmes.name_local: โปรแกรมสนับสนุนการพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรม (ITAP)
programmes.funder: สำนักงานพัฒนาวิทยาศาสตร์และเทคโนโลยีแห่งชาติ (NSTDA)
programmes.amount_note: NSTDA subsidises up to 50% of the cost of an expert-led technology improvement project for a Thai SME, historically capped around THB 400,000 per project, with the expert matched and managed by ITAP.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling. SMEs contact a regional ITAP network node, which scopes the project and assigns an expert.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the nearest ITAP network node (hosted by universities across Thailand).
ITAP staff conduct a diagnostic visit to identify the technology problem.
ITAP matches an expert and prepares the project proposal and budget.
SME signs the agreement and pays its share.
Expert delivers the project; ITAP monitors and reports.

eligibility.other_note: Thai-registered SMEs with at least 51% Thai shareholding. Focused on incremental technology upgrading rather than early-stage startups.

programmes.source_snippet: ITAP ช่วย SME ไทยพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรมโดยมีผู้เชี่ยวชาญให้คำปรึกษาและสนับสนุนค่าใช้จ่ายบางส่วน
